fields.Name: Email Engagement Trends
fields.Description: Skip analytics conversation from the More Cheese suite

fields.Message: How has our email open rate and click-through rate changed month by month this year? Show both metrics on the same chart. I'd like to click on a month to see the actual emails sent during that period. [NO CHAT]

Here you go, your Email Engagement & Monthly Performance Explorer tracks email trends across the year using data from Activities and People. It features KPI summary cards, a composite chart comparing Open Rate and Click-Through Rate side-by-side, and an interactive drill-down table to inspect individual sent emails for any selected month. Note that as outbound email activity logs are recorded, the metrics and charts will automatically populate.
